rationale: Contract clause 4.2 fixes EUR 1.00 = USD 1.10 for invoices dated in Q1 2026, so the PO price of EUR 210.00/EACH normalises to USD 231.00 — exactly the invoiced price (policy clause 7 conversion is normalisation, not a defect; clause 3 variance 0%).
